story.text: I have now spent about ten years living and learning with wiki. After trying many ways of running wikis and writing in them, I have started to settle into some patterns worth sharing.

The content for this wiki lives in three places. I edit the content on my laptop in a local wiki farm. I use the wiki static site generator ([https://github.com/fedwiki/wiki-ssg fedwiki/wiki-ssg]) to convert the localhost wiki into a static website that lives in another folder on my laptop. I use GitHub Pages to publish that folder to the Internet. [https://github.com/dobbs/deploy.wiki.do github]

Wiki is a medium in which I construct my own knowledge and understanding. I learn as I go. I build on what I have learned before. I build on what I have learned from others. As I construct and grow, my collaborators, with deeper insight into my interests, draw my attention to other sources. We construct shared knowledge while building our individual thinking.
